name: qkd_kvs_ctl_c32g-c32g-COMMIT
purpose: QR-CTL 10-21 STRUCTURAL successor of c32d (route 104fb88b7 NEEDS_RTL TT -164.64 / FF -45.62 / DRC0). (1) setup class boot_image_epoch[15] pin reg -> 16b epoch compare -> MU seal accept -> u_pa re-address -> word-address compare -> acc -> held/strobe select (855 ps logic): the u_pa/u_pb/u_pg re-address selects use seal_w (raw-word function) instead of the epoch-gated accept, and the dispatcher's word-address check runs on the RAW address in parallel (boot_seal ? next_word!=326 : raw!=next_word): epoch compare + seal accept + re-address mux leave the chain (~250 ps), 0 added edges, bit-exact (seal_w&&!as => v74=0 => tv=0). (2) FF class RESETN removal rst_n landing clone -> u_bobs.f2: qkd_static_kv_boot_observe_c32 resets only control/valid bits -- the 960 synchroniser data flops a1/a2/f1/f2/c1/c2 carry no reset, a local 2-flop valid shift masks the 2 stale stages after release (same outputs every edge); tile reset load -960 flops. SQ-COLLECT 10-21 successor of c32e/c32f (pre-gate native census FAIL max 161: u_bobs.v2 -> 160 applied_core masks; u_own g_bank_s32.dq2[0] 36): v2 = 5 kept copies (one per 32-bit applied_core slice) + v2f for fault; bank 2 reads its own kept cfg copy dq3. Same outputs every edge (benches unchanged PASS, mutants FAIL).
